fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that unidentified persons allegedly damaged the compound wall of the complainant near Selvapuram Puram Main Street at night. The matter was brought to Vellore North PS on 2026-04-06, while the incident was placed on 2026-04-06 around 19:20 hrs. Yogesh Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000359. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unidentified persons allegedly damaged the property while it was unattended.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, photograph, main street, CCTV, evening
